# In Three

> A three-command developer tutorial for running an owned Farcaster Snapchain node and browser client. Reads and signed writes go through the operator's node without a hosted Farcaster data API.

## Start here

- Human tutorial: https://farcaster.permanentupperclass.com/
- Simplified Chinese tutorial: https://farcaster.permanentupperclass.com/?lang=zh
- Agent runbook: https://farcaster.permanentupperclass.com/agent.md
- Source: https://github.com/P-U-C/farcaster-in-three
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/farcaster-in-three
- Container: https://github.com/orgs/P-U-C/packages/container/package/farcaster-in-three

## Core commands

    in-three provision
    in-three node up
    in-three client create

Use an existing suitable Ubuntu machine by default. Hetzner is optional through `in-three provision --hetzner`.

## Safety

Never request or expose a recovery phrase, browser password, cloud token, SSH private key, or payment key. Require human approval before spend, account funding, any Farcaster write, or teardown. Use a disposable test account.
